free_tier.stated: 5 GB LRS hot block storage, with 20,000 read and 10,000 write operations per month, free for 12 months. Azure Files: 100 GB LRS hot/cool/transaction-optimized, 12 months. Archive Storage: 10 GB LRS, 12 months.

egress.terms: Metered. 'First 100 GB/Month' egress free, then $0.087/GB from North America/Europe. 1 TiB/day of serving would be ~$80/day.

tooling: rclone backend 'azureblob' (Tier 1, md5, R/W); any S3-compatible SDK is NOT usable - it's the native Blob REST API; AzCopy, Azure Storage Explorer, azure-storage-blob Python SDK
chaining: Per-account 5 GB and accounts require a credit card for verification; the always-free grant is per Azure subscription. N subscriptions x 5 GB is not a serious multiplier and each needs billing verification.
limits_note: 5 GB cap; 12-month expiry on the Blob allotment (Azure's page labels Blob '12 months' despite the 'always free' framing elsewhere - treat as trial); 5 PiB max per storage account is irrelevant at 5 GB.
reliability_note: Card required; overage silently bills at pay-go rates once the 12-month window lapses because the account is not auto-suspended.

evidence.proved: 'Blob Storage ... 5 GB locally redundant storage (LRS) hot block with 20,000 read and 10,000 write operations' / '12 months'; 'Azure Files ... 100 GB of LRS transaction optimised, hot, and cool files' / '12 months'; 'Archive Storage ... 10 GB LRS storage' / '12 months'
'First 100 GB/Month' free, then '$0.087 per GB' from North America/Europe; 'Azure already offers the first 100 GB/month of egressed data for free'
